ns2:section.sectionText: Online & Continuing Education (OCE) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.oce.illinois.edu. There will be an additional class meeting on Wednesday, May 30. Class will not meet on Memorial Day, May 28. The course will be taught via Elluminate and Compass. Students will need a working external microphone/speakers or headset with microphone and reliable high-speed Internet. This section has one or more proctored exams, which may carry additional fees. Proctoring options include fee-based ProctorU and approved proctoring centers, and testing facilities located at the Online & Continuing Education offices on the Urbana-Champaign campus, which carry no fees.
